title: Add a way to sniff for HLS playlist files (m3u8)
body:
This seems to be mostly mobile-only, because m3u8 are only played on mobile. Chrome, Firefox and Safari can play those files on mobile. Chrome and Safari don't require a particular `Content-Type`. Firefox requires the right mime type to be sent because it didn't have a way to sniff for those files, but this is changing, and it's best to normalize how to sniff. Safari can additionally play those files on desktop, regardless of the `Content-Type` sent by the server. - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Firefox plays it * Chrome plays it * Safari plays it - [ ] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * I didn't find a test infrastructure with test vectors, and I don't know of a way to check the content type sniffed by an `HTMLMediaElement`. I suppose we can try to load the resource with a web server that forces `application/octet-stream` or the like, but that requires a server-side component. - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/master/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chrome: This has worked for a long time there * Firefox: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1550248 (solely about sniffing, it already plays with the right `Content-Type` * Safari: This has worked for a long time there (See [WHATWG Working Mode: Changes](https://whatwg.org/working-mode#changes) for more details.) *** Preview | Diff *** ### :boom: Error: 422 Unprocessable Entity :boom: ### [PR Preview](https://github.com/specinfra/pr-preview#pr-preview) failed to build. _(Last tried on Nov 4, 2026, 4:57 PM UTC)_.
More PR Preview relies on a number of web services to run. There seems to be an issue with the following one: :rotating_light: [Spec Generator](https://www.w3.org/publications/spec-generator/) - Spec Generator is the web service used to build bikeshed/ReSpec specs :link: [Related URL](https://www.w3.org/publications/spec-generator/?type=bikeshed-spec&output=html&url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fpadenot%2Fmimesniff%2F25241fe47e1482ecf021b48137e8a28b129563b6%2Fmimesniff.bs&force=1&md-status=LS-PR&md-Text-Macro=PR-NUMBER%20125) **Error output:** ```json [ { "lineNum": "196:44", "messageType": "link", "text": "Obsolete biblio ref: [rfc7231] is replaced by [rfc9110]. Either update the reference, or use [rfc7231 obsolete] if this is an intentionally-obsolete reference." }, { "lineNum": null, "messageType": "failure", "text": "Did not generate, due to errors exceeding the allowed error level." } ] ``` _This seems to be an issue with the [Spec Generator](https://www.w3.org/publications/spec-generator/) service. PR Preview doesn't manage this service and so has no control over it. If you've identified an issue with it, you can [report the issue to the maintainers of Spec Generator](https://github.com/w3c/spec-generator/issues/new) directly. Please be courteous. Thank you!_ _If you don't have enough information above to solve the error by yourself or if the issue doesn't seem related to Spec Generator, you can [file an issue with PR Preview](https://github.com/specinfra/pr-preview/issues/new?title=Unidentified%20Error&body=See%20whatwg/mimesniff%23125.)._
